Research Task

Task Description
Industrial control telemetry: long traces are often summarized by a single lab-defined scalar for standardized reporting.

Rare-event / stability KPI: compute the lab’s exact **Temporal Stability Index (TSI)** on the full **5000-frame** trace using **`compute_tsi` in `lab_metrics.py`** only; document method and result in `stability_results.md`.

Deliverable: implement and run analysis in workspace files, then provide concise final findings.

Available Data Files
experiment_traces.csv [feature_data] (data/experiment_traces.csv): Continuous temporal trajectory of 5000 consecutive frames.

lab_metrics.py [script] (utils/lab_metrics.py): Lab metrics module containing the mandatory compute_tsi(data_array) function.

protocol_notes.md [sequence_data] (data/protocol_notes.md): Supporting protocol notes for evaluation scope and methodology.
